name: Bug evidence plan writer
why: Ranks suspects with one check each before any code changes, the same order the game bug diagnosis skill follows for physics and timing bugs.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause before fixing and ends in a small pull request, the right path for a mechanic that breaks at some frame rates.

name: Turn a bug report into proof
why: Turns a player or tester report into a repeatable case and missing tests, useful during a Steam public beta.

name: Private bug evidence assistant
why: Turns rough play test notes and screenshots into a developer-ready issue with personal data masked.

name: Test list writer
why: Lists the cases to test, smallest first, before writing a mechanic or a save upgrade.

name: Test failure repair loop
why: Fixes a failing test suite in capped rounds without loosening tests, handy after a Unity version upgrade.

name: Make a code change in small tested steps with AI
why: Splits a change into small tested steps with rules for the AI helper, the same pattern the MonoBehaviour split prompt uses.

name: Function purity refactor planner
why: Pulls game rules out of hidden state into functions that depend only on inputs, which makes them testable in Edit Mode.

name: Fragile code spotter
why: Finds the few real risks in code an AI wrote fast, a useful pass over generated Unity scripts.

name: Pull request reviewer
why: Rates risk and ranks findings on each pull request, a second look before a mechanic is merged.

name: Release manager
why: Gives a go or no-go, changelog and rollback plan before each build goes to players.

name: Release day rollback planner
why: Plans the checks and the fallback build for release day, matching the default branch step of the Steam workflow.

name: Small usability test planner
why: Plans a short, structured play test with tasks and a fix list, useful for menus and onboarding levels.
